patterns: APPSC's favourite: Operation Polo = police action against the Nizam (asked repeatedly with distractors Blue Star, Meghdoot, Vijay, Tiger, Pearl).
Hyderabad who's who recurs in APPSC Group-2: Standstill Agreement, Kasim Razvi (Razakars), Laik Ali ('Hyderabad in Retrospect'), Moin Nawaz Jung (UNSC), Swami Ramananda Tirtha ('Join Indian Union').
Odd-one-out / identification items: Junagadh Nawab acceded to Pakistan; Bhopal is not among the three hold-outs; India referred Kashmir to UNSC.
Other PSCs: V.P. Menon's book, Patel's leadership, J&K accession 26 Oct 1947, privy purses abolished 1971, Standstill = Hyderabad.
App MCQs track PYQ facts closely; it adds Part A-D classification, Menon's phases and 1956 break-up of Hyderabad, all sound and APPSC-relevant.
